questions: Does 'count of integers' refer to the number of distinct integers in the subarray, or the total number of elements (length)?

Is the split position i inclusive of the first subarray and exclusive of the second, as indicated by (A_1,...,A_i) and (A_{i+1},...,A_N)?
Should the output be a single integer representing the maximum sum, or do we need to output the split position i as well?
Are there any constraints on memory or time complexity that should guide the implementation approach?
If 'count of integers' means length, is the sum simply i + (N-i) = N for all i, making the answer always N?
